In nature an unpalatable plant spreads under heavy grazing but does not take every gap, because edible plants re-establish too; the levers make the cap take fewer gaps or hold them for less time.

experiments.hypothesis: Hunters fail at killing, not at surviving: 80 to 92% of hunters never kill on every E113 lever, and spec-flip hunters (non-hunter brains in hunter bodies) are the zero-kill mass. Phase 1 of hunter-learning.md builds those as switches: flipReflex (a spec-flip child gets the hunter reflex), provisionEnabled (a hunter shares provisionShare 0.3 of each stored meal with its young hunters within 120), juvenileDependency (young hunters under 3000 ticks pay 0.6 of their movement cost and every hunter child gets a kin-pull floor).
